result.note: One statements question on India's July 2026 bilateral engagements, centred on the India-Israel Bilateral Investment Agreement entering into force.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's bilateral engagements in early July 2026:
items: The India–France Economic and Financial Dialogue in Aix-en-Provence ended with agreements signed on critical minerals cooperation.
India and Mali held their first exports forum in Bamako.
The India–Israel Bilateral Investment Agreement, signed in September 2025, came into force.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong: India and France discussed critical minerals and G20 and Paris Club alignment, but no agreements were signed. The India–Israel agreement came into force on 3 July 2026 and strengthens investor protections while preserving each government's room for public-policy regulation.
questions.source: The India-Israel Bilateral Investment Agreement, signed in September 2025, came into force on Friday, giving investors on both sides stronger protections while preserving each government's room for public-policy regulation.
